raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with the latest batches, the source sends reversals as separate rows with status 'REVERSAL' that point to the original via orig_txn_id. The original transactions keep status 'POSTED'. Before this, reversed transactions were flagged 'REVERSED' and excluded. The pipeline only filters on status='POSTED', so these reversed originals are still counted and inflate the most recent gold totals.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
